To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have designed, built, and tested a prototype of a 1.4 GeV electron linac for the Compressor Ring of the CLIC drive beam.
the bunch interlaced beam is stable in both rings, that the bunch length can be adjusted in the range 0.1 to 0.5 ps and the bunch charge can be adjusted from 1 to 5 pC.

The design and construction of a 35 A, 140 ns, 1.2 GeV electron beam compressor for the CTF3 test facility at CERN has been completed, including the development of a new bunch interlacing scheme, the design of the two rings and the transfer lines and the development of special components for the rings, such as the kicker magnets, the septum magnets, and the bunch length monitor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and testing of the main components of the CTF3 Compressor System.

the following aspects: (1) the design of the rings and of the intermediate transfer lines; (2) the design of special components (dipole, quadrupole, septum magnets, RF cavities); (3) measurements on prototypes of special components; (4) the development of a 3D electromagnetic code for the analysis of the beam dynamics and of the impedance budget.

the following topics: (a) design of the rings and of the transfer lines, (b) beam optics, (c) beam impedance, (d) RF system and beam loading, (e) beam diagnostics, (f) design of special components, (g) design of the control system, (h) design of the vacuum system, (i) beam dynamics simulations, (j) design and testing of the prototypes, (k) measurements and (l) design of the installation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of the CTF3 Compressor System is well advanced.
the CTF3 compressor system is a challenging project, but that the design and the development of the components have reached a satisfactory level.
the CTF3 bunch interlacing system is a very promising technique for the generation of short high peak current bunches for the future high energy linear colliders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CTF3 project has been successful in its aim of demonstrating the feasibility of the interlacing technique and the bunch compressor system.
the compressor is a very challenging system and that the design is now at a level that allows us to start building it.
all the design goals have been met.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to design a high quality lattice for a bunch compressor with a small number of magnets.
the CTF3 compressor system is feasible.
the design of the CTF3 compressor system is mature and the system is ready for the installation.
